answer: A new key stores a 256 MiB erasure shard in a hollow (sealed, payer-bound) and posts the Merkle root to a public lagoon auditors sample. It locks 2,400 POA yield-free 16 epochs and holds one lotus, a non-transferable petal. Each epoch a 48-byte Merkle-path quiz is due in 25s. Miss, replay, or a second lotus from the same payer burns 650 POA and seals the hollow 18 epochs. Honest cost: 2,400 POA plus 256 MiB; 600 fakes need 1.44 million POA and 150 GiB live storage, vs ~150 POA reward. Rented disks may go dark after the quiz; two surprise recitals slash lotuses sharing a disk fingerprint.
